LESSON: MSAMIATI

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.7: Msamiati

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Msamiati. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua nambari moja hadi kumi (1-) katika mazingira nambari hadi kumi hadi kumi yake
2. kuhesabu nambari 1- kwa za tarakimu kutumia majina mfuatano ili kujenga stadi ya yapi ya nambari kuzungumza kuonyeshwa nambari na kutaja jina la nambari moja hadi kumi

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua nambari moja hadi kumi (1-) katika mazingira nambari hadi kumi hadi kumi yake
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua nambari moja hadi kumi (1-) katika mazingira nambari hadi kumi hadi kumi yake. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuhesabu nambari 1- kwa za tarakimu kutumia majina mfuatano ili kujenga stadi ya yapi ya nambari kuzungumza kuonyeshwa nambari na kutaja jina la nambari moja hadi kumi
   In simple words: practise until you can kuhesabu nambari 1- kwa za tarakimu kutumia majina mfuatano ili kujenga stadi ya yapi ya nambari kuzungumza kuonyeshwa nambari na kutaja jina la nambari moja hadi kumi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Msamiati using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Msamiati in the examples.
2. Explain Msamiati to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Msamiati.
4. Show that you can: kutambua nambari moja hadi kumi (1-) katika mazingira nambari hadi kumi hadi kumi yake

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Msamiati using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Msamiati important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua nambari moja hadi kumi (1-) katika mazingira nambari hadi kumi hadi kumi yake
2. kuhesabu nambari 1- kwa za tarakimu kutumia majina mfuatano ili kujenga stadi ya yapi ya nambari kuzungumza kuonyeshwa nambari na kutaja jina la nambari moja hadi kumi

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
